'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Greg Shaw]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Plead My Case To The Senate]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
